Experience: Officers holding analogous post or holding the post of Chief Engineer Marine (Vessel)/Sr. Marine Engineer in a Major Port Trust in the scale of pay of Rs. 16000-20800 (Revised Rs. 80,000-2,20,000) with 1 year regular service in the grade and 5 years experience on a foreign going ship.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Cochin Port Authority Marine Engineering Superintendent Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.cochinport.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-12-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Marine Engineering Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form for the Marine Engineering Superintendent post at Cochin Port Authority is 7 December 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated office before this deadline through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Marine Engineering Superintendent under the Cochin Port Authority as per the official notification released for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a MOT I Class Motor Certificate or a Marine Engineering Officer Class I Certificate issued under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958, to be eligible for the Marine Engineering Superintendent position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Marine Engineering Superintendent?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Marine Engineering Superintendent post is 48 years. The crucial date for determining the age and eligibility criteria is 1 April 2027.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Marine Engineering Superintendent post will be entitled to a pay scale ranging from Rs. 90,000 to Rs. 2,40,000 per month, as specified in the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Marine Engineering Superintendent recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official document for any further updates regarding the application process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Marine Engineering Superintendent post is based on merit. This includes a thorough evaluation of the candidates' Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) or Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APARs) to ensure they meet the benchmark.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent to the office of the Secretary, Cochin Port Authority, Willingdon Island, Cochin-682 009, India. It must be sent through the proper channel with the necessary approvals.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach attested copies of APARs/ACRs for the last 5 years, qualification certificates, two passport-size photographs, a No-Objection Certificate, and specific annexures (III, IV, and V) as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if a candidate withdraws their candidature?
faq.answer: If a candidate withdraws their candidature after being selected, they will be liable for debarment from future selections to Deputy HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years.
